requirement: Build the diagnosis form reference data: every live clinical variable ordered by category then value type with its type-specific payload, every live antibiotic ordered by name with its group and AWaRe classification, and every live pathogen ordered by name; an empty variable list is a business rule violation.

preconditions.text: At least one live clinical variable exists
Reference antibiotics and pathogens exist and are live
The clinical variable table is empty or holds only soft-deleted rows

inputs.text: Form request with variables of every type plus reference data
Form request with variables, antibiotics, and pathogens
Form request whose numeric ranges sit on their boundaries
Form request with one clinical variable and no reference data
Form request with variables of several categories and value types
Form request with antibiotics inserted out of order
Form request when no clinical variable exists
Form request when every clinical variable is soft-deleted
Form request with pathogens inserted out of order

returns.text: Success with the clinical variables, antibiotics, and pathogens
Variables ordered by category then value type with their type-specific payload
Antibiotics and pathogens ordered by name ascending
Failure with BusinessRuleViolation when no live clinical variable exists

exception_text: No unhandled exception; a missing variable set is returned as a failed Result
